title: Smallest Substring With Identical Characters I
summary: Given a binary string and a limit on the number of operations, you can flip at most that many bits.
statement: Given a binary string and a limit on the number of operations, you can flip at most that many bits. The goal is to minimize the length of the longest substring with identical characters. Return the minimized length.
constraints: s has 1–1,000 binary characters and 0 <= num_ops <= len(s).
Flip at most num_ops individual bits.
Minimize the maximum length of any consecutive equal-character run.
reference_solution:
def minimum_longest_binary_run(s,num_ops):
    n=len(s)
    def possible(limit):
        if limit==1:
            first=sum(char!=('0' if index%2==0 else '1') for index,char in enumerate(s))
            return min(first,n-first)<=num_ops
        needed=run=0
        for index,char in enumerate(s):
            run+=1
            if index==n-1 or char!=s[index+1]:needed+=run//(limit+1);run=0
        return needed<=num_ops
    low=1;high=n
    while low<high:
        middle=(low+high)//2
        if possible(middle):high=middle
        else:low=middle+1
    return low
